    org.checkerframework.framework.util.defaults.QualifierDefaults.addCheckedCodeDefault(AnnotationMirror, TypeUseLocation, boolean)
    applyToSubpackages has no effect, because a checked-code default is not scoped to a package. Use QualifierDefaults.addCheckedCodeDefault(AnnotationMirror, TypeUseLocation), or QualifierDefaults.addPackageDefault(javax.lang.model.element.PackageElement, javax.lang.model.element.AnnotationMirror, org.checkerframework.framework.qual.TypeUseLocation, boolean) for a default of one package that need not apply to its subpackages.

    org.checkerframework.javacutil.ElementUtils.isElementFromByteCode(Element)
    Use !isElementFromSourceCode(elt) to check if an element is not being compiled from source. If you also need to account for stub files, use AnnotatedTypeFactory.isFromByteCode(Element). This method is deprecated because its semantics are rarely what is desired: it returns true if a classfile exists for the given element, even if it is also being compiled from source.
    org.checkerframework.javacutil.ElementUtils.isError(Element)
    This method is unused and will be removed. Its name is misleading: it returns false for every erroneous element except a SymbolNotFoundError.
